entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Krishna Deo Raj, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs. Madhuri Lata, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
 Oral Order
2 31-01-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to make necessary corrections in the prayer portion of this application.

3. The present application has been filed against the order dated 08.07.2022 passed by the S.D.J.M.,
Sheikhpura in connection with Sheikhpur Mahila P.S. Case No.02 of 2022, whereby and whereunder cognizance has been taken against the petitioner and others under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Sheikhpur Mahila P.S. Case No.02 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.74193 of 2023(2) dt.31-01-2026 is the second round of litigation under Section 498A of the I.P.C. filed by the opposite party no.2.
With regard to the stage of the case, he has submitted that probably charges have been framed.
Upon instructions, he submits that witnesses have not been examined and as such, the trial has not proceeded.
5. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 under both process i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks.
6. Also, call for a report regarding stage of the case in connection with Sheikhpura Mahila P.S. Case No.02 of 2022 from the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Sheikhpura.
